blocks.content: Recognize ESD-sensitive parts and basic ESD workstation behavior.

items.definition: To prevent ESD damage to avionics: (1) use a properly grounded anti-static wrist strap, and (2) handle components ONLY at ESD-protected workstations.
items.analogy: Like handling photographic film in a darkroom — the environment must be specially controlled before you open the package, not after.

blocks.question: A technician needs to remove a CMOS processor board from an avionics LRU. Which protective practice is required?
choices: Wear latex gloves and hold the board by its edges
Work quickly to minimize exposure time to ambient static
Use a properly grounded anti-static wrist strap and work only at an ESD-protected station
Ground the LRU chassis only — the board does not need additional protection
blocks.feedback: ESD damage can be caused by static discharge too small to feel. A grounded wrist strap and ESD-protected workstation are both required to safely handle CMOS and other static-sensitive components.
